title: Privacy Policy | Duke Gallo
description: How dukegallo.com collects, uses, and protects the information you share through its contact and career forms, and how to reach Duke Gallo with privacy questions.
body_html:
Last updated October 29, 2026

Privacy policy

This policy explains what information dukegallo.com collects, how it's used, and the choices you have. The site is operated by Duke Gallo, a licensed mortgage loan originator (NMLS #2084855).

Information we collect

  • Information you submit. When you use a form on this site, we collect what you enter, such as your name, email address, phone number, the kind of help you're looking for, and any message you write. Please don't submit Social Security numbers, account numbers, or other sensitive financial information through these forms.
  • Technical information. Our hosting provider, Netlify, processes standard server data such as IP addresses and browser information to deliver and secure the site. This site does not use advertising cookies or third-party analytics trackers.
  • Embedded content. Some pages load fonts from Google Fonts and photos from Unsplash. Those services may receive your IP address when your browser requests those files.

How we use it

  • To respond to your inquiry by phone, text, or email, as you requested
  • To discuss home financing options or career opportunities with you
  • To keep the site secure and working properly

How information is shared

We don't sell your personal information, and we don't share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. Form submissions are stored by Netlify, our website host, and delivered to Duke by email. If you choose to move forward with a loan or a career conversation, your information may be shared with the mortgage company Duke works with, and with service providers who help process a loan, as needed to serve you and as required by law.

Your choices and California rights

You can ask us to tell you what personal information we have about you, to correct it, or to delete it, and you can ask us to stop contacting you at any time. California residents may have additional rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act. To make a request, contact us using the details below. We won't discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

Some browsers send a "Do Not Track" signal. Because this site doesn't use cross-site tracking, it doesn't respond differently to that signal.

Retention and security

We keep form submissions only as long as needed to respond to you and to meet legal and regulatory recordkeeping requirements. The site is served over an encrypted (HTTPS) connection.

Children

This site isn't intended for children under 16, and we don't knowingly collect their information.

Contact

Questions or requests about this policy: email dgallo@westcapitallending.com or call (949) 688-5959.

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it last changed.
